caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object that appears to be a copper or brass oil lamp or vessel, set against a plain, off-white background. The object has a conical base that flares outward at the bottom, supporting a narrow cylindrical stem that leads up to a cylindrical body with a conical lid. A small finial sits at the peak of the lid, colored gold or yellow. Protruding to the right from the body is a spout or nozzle, also made of the same coppery material, which appears to be hollow. Attached to the left side of the body is a simple circular ring or handle. The object is rendered in shades of reddish-brown, with areas of highlight suggesting a metallic surface, and some subtle changes in tone indicating depth and reflections. There is a small, faint inscription beneath the object, which includes the name "William H. Edwards" and what appears to be a date or code.
title: Whale Oil Lamp
